definitions: To ignore an unpleasant reality or avoid dealing with a difficult situation by pretending it doesn't exist.
To refuse to acknowledge a problem or danger.
examples: You can't just bury your head in the sand and hope the financial problems go away.
It's time to stop burying your head in the sand and face the truth.
Many people bury their head in the sand when it comes to climate change.
lemma: bury your head in the sand
source: bury your head in the sand
